title: campanula scheuchzeri var. styriaca
intro: Campanula scheuchzeri var. styriaca, commonly known as Alpine Harebell, is a flowering plant species belonging to the bellflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Harebell are attributed to its ability to exhibit expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
